_comment: Subscription model. The affiliate programmes rejected the publisher, so
this is the second revenue engine: a free public tier for everyone, and
a paid tier for people who want to act on the data.
The paid tier is NOT a paywall around the calculator. The calculator
stays free for everyone - that is what makes the SEO work. What is
paid is the part that takes work to use:
- Trip alerts: get an email when a price changes for a destination
- Watchlists: save destinations and get notified about them
- The full data export: every price point, every carrier, every
currency, as CSV/JSON
- The pricing-error monitor: a feed of newly-found inversions
The backend is Appwrite: Auth for the subscriber's account, TablesDB
for the subscriber and watchlist records, and a Function for the
premium API and the Stripe billing.
Enforcement is server-side. The static site is public; the premium
DATA is simply not served without a valid entitlement. Nothing is
hidden by obfuscating the client.
The Appwrite session JWT is what identifies the caller, so a client
cannot fake its identity or upgrade its own plan. The subscriber record
is the source of truth for the plan.
Payment is Stripe: Checkout for the subscription, the customer portal
for self-service cancellation, and a webhook for the lifecycle events.
NOTE: Stripe does not support businesses registered in Tunisia, so a
Stripe account has to come from a supported country - see
docs/MONETIZATION.md for the options.
_appwrite_comment: The backend is Appwrite: Auth for the subscriber's account, TablesDB
for the subscriber and watchlist records, and a Function for the
premium API and the Stripe billing.
'project_id' is the Appwrite project. 'endpoint' is the regional
Appwrite API endpoint for that project.

_comment: The Stripe price ids for each plan and billing period. These are
written by scripts/stripe-setup.mjs, which creates the products and
the recurring prices in Stripe and then pushes the ids to the
function. The function reads them as STRIPE_PRICE_PRO,
STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_YEARLY, STRIPE_PRICE_TEAM and
STRIPE_PRICE_TEAM_YEARLY.
The secret key and the webhook signing secret are NOT here: they
live on the Appwrite Function as secret variables, because a secret
in a file that is committed to git is not a secret.

Full price and coverage data export (CSV + JSON)
The pricing-error monitor, updated as it is found

team.label: Team

_comment: The free tier must stay generous. The site's value as a search and
referral asset depends on the calculator being completely free, and
a paywalled calculator ranks far worse.
The Worker serves the site and the premium API. It is NOT in front
of the static site for the free pages - those are served by GitHub
Pages. The Worker only fronts the premium endpoints and the
entitlement check, so the free experience stays fast and free.
